therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with early Parkinson disease previously stabilized on pramipexole immediate release
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: percentage of patients who successfully switched from pramipexole IR to pramipexole ER (defined as no change in UPDRS II+III by more than 15% from baseline to week 9)

results.effect_size: 84.5% (ER) vs 94.2% (IR) successfully switched; Risk Difference = -10.75 (95% CI: -20.51 to 1.48)
subgroup_findings: At week 4 (no dose adaptation): 81.6% ER vs 92.3% IR successfully switched (p=0.0803)
UPDRS II+III change from baseline at week 9: -1.6 (ER) vs -0.5 (IR), mean difference -1.1 (95% CI: -2.8 to 0.6), p=0.2061
UPDRS II change from baseline at week 9: -0.3 (ER) vs -0.1 (IR), mean difference -0.2 (95% CI: -0.8 to 0.4), p=0.4694
UPDRS III change from baseline at week 9: -1.2 (ER) vs -0.3 (IR), mean difference -0.9 (95% CI: -2.3 to 0.4), p=0.1804
Mean final daily dose: 2.75 mg (ER) vs 2.83 mg (IR)

dose_info.dose: 2.75 mg (ER mean final); 2.83 mg (IR mean final)
dose_info.dose_modifications: Dose adaptation allowed after week 4 if needed

subgroups.raw_descriptor: PGI-I responder (unchanged to very much better)
